Its ac_test_permissions model permits supervisor WP0 writes, denies user writes to read-only pages, and adds leaf A/D only when access succeeds.
validation_adaptations.adaptation: Retain the WP0-success/WP1-fault sequence using actual fetched MOV CR0 between generated scalar operations, a legacy32 read-only 4-KiB leaf at DATA=0x100000, and a warm native writable mapping from the first store. Verify the later write faults with PF3, keeps EAX=0xffffffff and CR2=DATA, preserves the earlier dword0x10011, and revokes native write permission on control commit. The independent model also checks user WP0 writes fail with PF7 in host-side semantic tests.
